# Lighthouse Macro

> Institutional-grade macro and economic intelligence, built on framework and process. Founded and run by Bob Sheehan, CFA, CMT. Tagline: Macro, Illuminated.

Lighthouse Macro reads the economic cycle through the Diagnostic Dozen: twelve macro pillars across three engines (Macro Dynamics, Monetary Mechanics, Market Structure). The pillars feed proprietary composites and a master risk index (MRI), surfaced on a public live dashboard. The framework serves two audiences: market participants (advisors, allocators, CIOs) and operators (CEOs, CFOs, founders) who need macro for capital, hiring, and capex decisions.

## Start here
- [Start Here](https://lighthousemacro.com/start-here.html): what Lighthouse Macro is, how the framework works, and where to begin
- [The Diagnostic Dozen](https://lighthousemacro.com/framework.html): the twelve-pillar framework and its three engines, free to read in full
- [Methodology](https://lighthousemacro.com/methodology.html): principles, process, the three-layer recession framework, and the technical guardrails

## Research
- [The Reading Room](https://lighthousemacro.com/research/): every published piece, indexed on this domain
- [Research on Substack](https://research.lighthousemacro.com): where the publications are delivered. The Beacon (long-form flagship), The Beam (short, single-thesis), Notes (free), The Chartbook, and The Horizon (forward outlook)

## Pharos and membership
- [Pharos](https://lighthousemacro.com/pharos/): the research terminal the publications are written from, with live boards and 60+ proprietary indicators
- [Pricing](https://lighthousemacro.com/#pricing): the Diagnostic Dozen, the methodology, and the free Notes are open to everyone. Research + Pharos membership is $500 a year or $50 a month. The Watch is $1,500 a year
- Advisory for firms and operators (Advisor, Institutional, Fractional CIO for RIAs with $200M to $2B in AUM, and Operator): advisory@lighthousemacro.com
